dream_report_en: I am on a bridge that is somewhat similar to a bridge in [city]; a bridge that leads over a road, I am probably waiting for a bus; I look at the area, below it is a small river, that coincides with what I know from [this city]; next to it is another bridge, there is a loudspeaker mounted under it and some noise came out of it, I don't know exactly; and then I notice that I'm standing on the wrong bridge, because I want to get on the bus and it leaves from the other bridge; it then seemed completely normal to me that I have to get over there, and I close my eyes and imagin that I am over there, and then I was on the other bridge; I think I had to do that again in order to position myself correctly, but I can't place it well now; then the bus comes and that also fits, it looks exactly like the city buses and without having to go to the ticket machine, specifically, I got myself a ticket, which I then looked at and the layout was a bit different, there was an ink print on it that was a bit washed out; a ticket inspector actually is coming; the first thing I thought was that the ticket inspector looks much nicer than they normally do; in real life they are always very strict guys with their hair braided back; it was the same person I remember, with red hair but she has changed, become nicer; she then asked to see the ticket and asked what I had written on it, in response I justified myself by saying that it was the ink that had been smeared on the printout; that was OK for her, she then went on to the next person, who already looked a bit caught and pulled out a piece of paper and then said, yes I have a ticket and it was obviously something completely different, it looked more like from a shelter where he is at the moment and he dictated a string of letters to her and that's where the sequence ends; I had a rough idea of where I was when I was there on the bridge and when I was on the bus it continued to look like I was still outside, I continued to see the sky and the surroundings, and so on, and I can also categorize that emotionally from what I saw; it looked like the meeting point where all the buses meet, like a bus station, and that's roughly where when the control took place.
